learning_objective: 🎯 Supercharge your word power with twins, opposites, and secret phrase meanings to make your writing absolutely brilliant!

main_concepts.simple_explanation: Synonyms are different words that have the exact same or very similar meaning. Using synonyms stops your writing from being boring! Instead of always saying 'big', you can say 'huge', 'gigantic', or 'enormous'.
Antonyms are words that mean the absolute exact opposite of each other. Think of day and night, hot and cold, or brave and cowardly. They help create strong contrast in your sentences.

Idioms are fun, secret phrases where the words together do not mean what they actually say! For example, if a test is 'a piece of cake', it means the test was very easy, not that it is an actual dessert!

fun_activity.title: 🚀 The Synonym Upgrade
fun_activity.instructions: Take the boring sentence 'The good dog ate the big bone.' Grab a dictionary or thesaurus and upgrade the words 'good' and 'big' into the fanciest, smartest synonyms you can find!

quick_recap: ⭐ Synonyms have similar meanings and make your writing more exciting to read.
⭐ Antonyms show opposites, and Idioms are creative expressions with hidden meanings that native speakers use!
